_: Local corrections to OpenStreetMap applied by build.mjs (the owner knows these roads). twoWay: OSM way ids to treat as two-way. bridge: OSM way ids to treat as bridges (they take the surveyed deck in city worlds). ramp: OSM ways that run straight between their neighbours' end heights and count as bridge (a short approach the survey can't see as a deck). decks: OSM ways of bridges whose deck height to force: 'raised' (follow the survey even where trees / parapets break it up) or 'low' (keep the road's heights).
